author: Sebastian FL Daily Brief
title: 🐱 Gentle Sebastian Cats Ready for Adoption and New Homes
text:
7 hours ago These Sebastian kitties have been through a lot and are now safe at H.A.L.O. No Kill Rescue . They’re fixed up, loved, and just waiting for the right person to bring them home.
Tangelo Breed: Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby Gender: Male Color: Orange tabby (bottle-baby sweetheart) Adoption Fee: $125 Shelter: H.A.L.O. No Kill Rescue — (772) 589-7297 Tangelo lost his mom at birth and was raised in an incubator by loving foster caregivers, bottle-fed around the clock. All that early care helped him grow into a classic bottle-baby cuddle bug who loves people and close contact. He’s playful, sweet, and full of zest, just like his citrusy name.
👉 Meet Tangelo and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Damon Breed: Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby (about 8 weeks when rescued) Gender: Male Color: Gray, Russian Blue–style look Adoption Fee: $125 Shelter: H.A.L.O. No Kill Rescue — (772) 589-7297 Damon was found alone in the middle of a busy road, a very scary place for a tiny kitten. He can be a bit cautious at first, but he’s learning every day that people can be kind and gentle. With his striking gray coat and classic Russian Blue vibes, he’s a handsome little guy who just needs a patient, loving home to help his confidence bloom.
👉 Meet Damon and apply to adopt on adoptapet
